DLC2303:4:t_000:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「You finally seem a little motivated.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「This is a good opportunity. I'll teach you what reality is like.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:20.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Here I come, Ensign $$リディ$$...!」

DLC2303:4:t_000:21.en:
$$リディ$$
（$$バナージ$$... Even in a mock battle, I won't lose to you...!）

DLC2303:4:t_001:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough, Ensign $$リディ$$. The $$デルタプラス$$'s damage has been judged to exceed its operational limits.」

DLC2303:4:t_001:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「One more time, please, Captain $$アムロ$$! If we do it again...!」

DLC2303:4:t_001:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There are no second chances on the battlefield.」

DLC2303:4:t_001:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Take a good look at yourself, $$リディ$$. If this had been a real battle, you'd be dead.」

DLC2303:4:t_001:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Emotion gives you the strength to live, but don't think a man who drowns in it can move forward.」

DLC2303:4:t_002:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ghh...! The $$ユニコーン$$'s damage has exceeded its limits!」

DLC2303:4:t_003:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough, Ensign $$リディ$$. You win.」

DLC2303:4:t_003:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Results are all that matter on the battlefield. I have no complaints about your victory.」

DLC2303:4:t_003:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But don't forget. Emotion gives you the strength to live, but a man who drowns in it can't move forward.」

DLC2303:4:t_003:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And $$バナージ$$... I told you to fight seriously.」

DLC2303:4:t_003:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「'He's an ally'... Don't think that excuse will hold up on the battlefield.」

DLC2303:4:t_003:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Remember the battle in $$ダカール$$. Even if you have no intention of fighting, your opponent may come at you intending to kill.」

DLC2303:4:t_005:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop, Ensign $$リディ$$. Time's up.」

DLC2303:4:t_005:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Please let us settle this! I...」

DLC2303:4:t_005:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Calm down, $$リディ$$. Do you think you can win when you've lost your composure like this?」

DLC2303:4:t_005:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Emotion gives you the strength to live, but a man who drowns in it can't move forward.」

DLC2303:4:t_005:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And $$バナージ$$... I told you to fight seriously.」

DLC2303:4:t_005:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「'He's an ally'... Don't think that excuse will hold up on the battlefield.」

DLC2303:4:t_005:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Remember the battle in $$ダカール$$. Even if you have no intention of fighting, your opponent may come at you intending to kill.」

DLC2303:4:t_006:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（This doesn't seem to have solved anything...）

DLC2303:4:t_006:1.en:
$$カツ$$
（If anything, hasn't it gotten worse...?）

DLC2303:4:t_006:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... What exactly was the point of this training?」

DLC2303:4:t_006:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Training is training. As your commander, I don't want you to die... That's all there is to it.」

DLC2303:4:t_006:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「What...!? You weren't trying to get $$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ to make up...?」

DLC2303:4:t_006:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's their problem. It's not my place to interfere.」

DLC2303:4:t_006:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But if you die, everything ends. Every possibility, every hope, is cut off right there.」

DLC2303:4:t_006:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why I'll train you and teach you how to survive. What you do after that is up to you.」

DLC2303:4:t_006:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$...! I've confirmed a force approaching our position!」

DLC2303:4:t_007:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「To find such unexpected prey on patrol... Luck is on my side.」

DLC2303:4:t_007:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A purple $$ギラ・ズール$$...! $$フル・フロンタル$$'s Guards captain!」

DLC2303:4:t_007:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$, $$バナージ$$! Fall back!」

DLC2303:4:t_008:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Anyone carrying needless doubts has no place on the battlefield! I don't have time to look after someone like that!」

DLC2303:4:t_009:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't intend to die either!」

DLC2303:4:t_010:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! I'm not letting you take all the glory!」

DLC2303:4:t_011:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Like hell I'm going to die! I haven't... done anything yet!」

DLC2303:4:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. As long as you know that, you won't die so easily.」

DLC2303:4:t_011:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$カツ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$! We're going in too!」

DLC2303:4:t_011:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I don't intend to die until I get $$クェス$$ back either!」

DLC2303:4:t_012:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What...!? Why is their morale so high!?」

DLC2303:4:t_012:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, spread out! Stay alive until we reach $$アクシズ$$!」

DLC2303:4:t_012:3.en:
$$リディ$$
（$$バナージ$$...! We'll put our contest on hold for now!）

DLC2303:4:t_013:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「Good... The enemy force is wiped out.」

DLC2303:4:t_013:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The decisive battle at $$アクシズ$$ is almost here. They probably weren't committing everything to this either.」

DLC2303:4:t_014:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You seem to have cleared your head a little, $$バナージ$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_014:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Live the way you think is right. The results will follow.」

DLC2303:4:t_014:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That might sound irresponsible, but take it as advice from someone who's been around longer.」

review.context: Alternate mock-battle outcomes show Amuro correcting emotional Riddhe and hesitant Banagher. A Neo Zeon patrol interrupts; Amuro's real purpose is to teach survival, and both younger pilots commit to staying alive.
decisions: Repeated outcome branches are translated independently in their matching rows.
Amuro's warning preserves the distinction between emotion as life force and being consumed by it.
Full Frontal is the Guard commander's leader; Geara Zulu remains distinct from Emperor Zuul.
